title: Fix _sim_window_match for newer Xcode window-title format (en dash, no parens)
description:
_sim_window_match() only recognized Simulator window titles in the "<device> (<runtime>)" form (parens). Newer Xcode/macOS builds (observed 2026-09-06, macOS 26.6.2 on mac-studio, Xcode shipping iOS 26.5 runtimes) title windows "<device> - iOS <version>" (en dash, "iOS" prefix, no parens) instead.

Every AppleScript-driven interaction that depends on window lookup (tap, swipe, long-press, type, _get_sim_bounds) failed outright with "Could not get device content bounds for simulator <udid>. AXGroup error: ... Window error: Can't get window 1 of process Simulator whose name = ... or name starts with ... (-1719)" against a real, correctly-named, visible Simulator window. show/hide silently no-op'd instead of erroring (AppleScript error swallowed by capture_output + check=False), which made the bug much harder to spot — worth a follow-up to surface that failure instead of swallowing it.

Found and fixed ad hoc while proving Demix end-to-end across two Macs (demix repo, task T-LU-571, see demix-v2/analysis/app-state/e2e.html). Fix: extended the match predicate to accept both "(<runtime>)" and " - iOS <version>" forms, anchored the same exact-or-startswith-with-separator way so a short device name still cannot greedy-match a longer one that shares its prefix.

Shipped as commit 34a8e4c (version bump 0.4.0 -> 0.4.1, tests green 662/662, gate passed) via the release pre-push gate, not through this project's own keel-tracked SDLC — filing this after the fact per house rule (a fix nobody can find is a fix that gets made again).

context.text: Partial progress: the core fix (predicate now matching both title formats) is shipped in commit 34a8e4c, version 0.4.1, tests green 662/662. Left as todo because two acceptance criteria are not yet done: no regression test added for the new title format, and show/hide still silently swallow the AppleScript error instead of surfacing a real failure when the window cannot be found.

acceptanceCriteria: sim_window_match recognizes both the legacy device-plus-parens and the newer device-dash-iOS-version window-title forms
tap/swipe/long-press/type succeed against a real Simulator window titled in the newer form (regression test added)
show/hide surface a real failure instead of silently swallowing the AppleScript error when the window cannot be found
proofRequirements: test run showing the new window-title-format case passing; already true in prod for 0.4.1, commit 34a8e4c
